documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Purple United Sales Limited reported significant financial and operational growth for FY26, driven by a rapid expansion in its exclusive brand outlets (EBOs) to over 100 stores and a strategic shift towards retail and omnichannel operations. Management highlighted a 65% jump in top-line revenue to ₹170 Cr and a 76% increase in EBITDA to ₹36.58 Cr, supported by improved contributions from retail and e-commerce segments. The company plans to double its retail footprint and maintain a strong focus on premium kids' fashion and footwear categories while optimizing working capital and inventory discipline. Purple United Sales Limited reported its H2 and FY26 financial and operational performance, highlighting revenue growth to 17,063.21 Lakhs and an increase in Exclusive Brand Outlets to 111 across 22 states. Management discussed its cluster-led expansion strategy, omnichannel presence across marketplaces and its D2C website, and a credit rating assignment by CRISIL.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company can easily double its revenue on a year-to-year basis for the next two years.
guidance.quote: That is very easily achievable in the next two years. For the next two years, that guidance I can give we can easily develop the top line by 100% on a year-to-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management targeted that e-commerce business will contribute at least 12% to 14% to the overall top line in the current year.
guidance.quote: So, we are hopeful that overall e-commerce business will contribute at least 12 to 14% overall top line in this year.

guidance.claim: The company targets the e-commerce business contribution to reach around 10-12% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Ideally, we are targeting around 10-12% should come from our e-commerce business in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects gross margin variations to stay within a range of plus or minus 25 to 50 basis points in the future.
guidance.quote: So, broadly, you can say, plus minus 25-50 basis point, we'll leave the dimension in the margin we can expect in future.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the kids' market has immense growth potential in Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities.
demand_outlook.quote: And the potential to grow our plan in Tier 1 and Tier 2 is immense.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observes immense gaps and positive growth prospects in the kids premium fashion category.
demand_outlook.quote: talking about the gross prospect we see an immense gap in the premium, Kids premium fashion as a category.

demand_outlook.claim: Winter wear demand is characterized by need-based buying with higher ASPs and continued growth compared to last year.
demand_outlook.quote: winter is a need-based buying, and then the ASPs are high, but we are seeing growth via-via the last year numbers, so I have not seen any impact on these aspects

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company expanded from 43 stores as of March 31, 2025, to around 111 stores as of April 30, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: As I mentioned, we expanded from 43 stores as on 31st March 2025 to around 111 stores as at 30th April, 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: Management noted that the company opened its 100th store at Lawrence Road.
capex_expansion.quote: If you're not aware, we opened our 100th store at Lawrence Road, which is one of the premium high streets in that region, and got a very decent mileage for that opening.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operates 90-plus retail stores and expects to reach the three-figure mark within the month.
capex_expansion.quote: As we speak, we have 90-plus retail stores, and, Hopefully, will be reaching three-figure mark, in this month only.

capex_expansion.claim: There are approximately 30 stores currently in the project stage.
capex_expansion.quote: See, around, 30 stores are still are in the project stage.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that top-line revenue grew to ₹170 Cr and EBITDA grew by 76% from ₹20.73 Cr to ₹36.58 Cr.
margins_costs.quote: From ₹103 Cr, we have done a top line of ₹170 Cr with 65% growth. Accordingly, EBITDA has grown from ₹20.73 Cr to ₹36.58 Cr a jump of 76%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that stores with a vintage of above 1 year operate at an EBITDA margin of 22%.
margins_costs.quote: If we analyze, if I exclude last 6-month stores, then the EBITDA comes to around 20%, and stores with vintage of above 1 year, the EBITDA is at 22%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 21% for FY26 compared to 20% for FY25.
Core and essential product margins range from 55% to 56%, while fashion or seasonal items can reach 60% to 63%.
margins_costs.quote: So, just to give you an example, there are probably 3 categories, core, essential, fashion, or seasonal. So, core and essential, the margins may be in the range of 55% to 56%, but if we talk about the fashion, or the some seasonal item, the margin may climb to 60% to 63%.

margins_costs.claim: The company is spending around 3% to 4% on marketing currently.
margins_costs.quote: In marketing, I will tell you, around, 3-4% we're spending currently on marketing

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported that the D2C website receives daily orders of roughly 300 orders per day.
orders_capacity.quote: And if we talk of numbers, we are getting daily orders of roughly 300 orders per day, and we are very hopeful that in another 3 to 4 months we will be touching a 4-digit order number from our website only.

orders_capacity.claim: The mother warehouse has a 30,000 square feet facility supplying goods to all channel partners.
orders_capacity.quote: It's a 30,000 square feet facility, is our mother warehouse from where we are supplying goods to all our channel partners, which is EBOs.

orders_capacity.claim: The company handles approximately 300 orders per day on other marketplaces.
orders_capacity.quote: If we talk of the marketplace, other marketplace, we have around 300 orders per day.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that CRISIL assigned the company a BBB- Stable rating, which is an investment-grade rating.
capital_allocation.quote: We have recently been rated by CRISIL, which will be BBB- Stable rating, which is an investable grade rating.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the company plans to raise equity and debt to maintain a healthy debt and equity ratio.
capital_allocation.quote: It has to be a balance of debt and equity. It will be through both the routes. And so, we'll be maintaining a healthy debt and equity ratio. So, we plan to raise equity also, and there'll be certain requirements of debt as and when the need requires.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that expansion in the Middle East was deferred due to unfavorable current market dynamics and the war situation.
risks_headwinds.quote: We participated in an event in the Middle East also, and we would have loved to expand in the Middle East, but the current market dynamics, current macro environment is not supporting. Let the things stabilize, I think then we'll be able to take a call on that.

risks_headwinds.claim: Business processes are becoming more complex, requiring senior hiring and marketing expenditures as the store count exceeds 100.
risks_headwinds.quote: on the other side, since the business processes are becoming more complex, we are hiring senior person also, and with the 100-plus stores, we'll have to spend some amount in marketing also.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company is hopeful of reaching a database of roughly 1 million customers in 5 to 6 months.
management_commitments.quote: Currently, we have around 2 lakh customer bases, and we are hopeful that in another 5 to 6 months we will be having a database of roughly 1 million customers for better customer engagement.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company expects to touch a 4-digit daily order number from its website only in another 3 to 4 months.
management_commitments.quote: And if we talk of numbers, we are getting daily orders of roughly 300 orders per day, and we are very hopeful that in another 3 to 4 months we will be touching a 4-digit order number from our website only.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company expects to be operationally cash positive in another 12 to 18 months.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are very hopeful going by the past trend. So, you mentioned that we have already done an improvement. So, we are very hopeful that we should be operationally cash positive maybe another 12 to 18 months.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to scale website orders to 400 orders per day within the next 2 to 3 months.
management_commitments.quote: And we are hopeful that this will be scaled to 400 in another 2 to 3 months.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets 10-12% contribution from the e-commerce business in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Ideally, we are targeting around 10-12% should come from our e-commerce business in FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
